direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow and depth in the cinematic scene; 160-220ms ease-out selection, one 240ms route trace on real state change; cinematic transitions between steps; prefers-reduced-motion removes flow and transitions while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; compact horizontal rail only; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; separate reserved side zones for connection readiness checking provider identity and the distinct investigation evidence task, each with own heading, status and control; action bar with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; pending proposals remain untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved plan may coexist while replacements await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
